import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if needed
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Suppress progress bars
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_DISTRIBUTED"] = "0"

print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Starting...")
start_time = time.time()

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Identify target columns
label_names = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col in label_names]
y_train_raw = train_df[label_names].values.astype(np.float64)

# Prepare training and validation splits
val_ratio = 0.2

# Extract features and labels separately for clarity
X_train_all = train_df[["id", "comment_text"]].copy()
y_train_all = y_train_raw.copy()

# Split with proper indices tracking to avoid dimension mismatch
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    range(len(X_train_all)),
    test_size=val_ratio,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_all.sum(axis=1).astype(int),
)

X_train = X_train_all.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
X_val = X_train_all.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
y_train = y_train_all.iloc[train_idx].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
y_val = y_train_all.iloc[val_idx].copy().reset_index(drop=True)

# Get comment texts separately for vectorization
X_train_comments = X_train["comment_text"].values
X_val_comments = X_val["comment_text"].values

print(
    f"\n[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] After split - Train: {len(X_train_comments)}, Val: {len(X_val_comments)}"
)

# Feature extraction - fit on training ONLY
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, stop_words="english"
)
X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_comments)
X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_val_comments)

print(
    f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] TFIDF shapes - Train: {X_train_tfidf.shape}, Val: {X_val_tfidf.shape}"
)

# Model architecture - one model per toxicity column
n_models = len(label_names)
models = []
model_scores = {}

for i, label in enumerate(label_names):
    print(f"\n[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Training model for {label}...")

    # Check which class has majority to handle imbalanced classes
    y_col = y_train[:, i]

    print(
        f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Labels for {label}: train={len(y_col)}, pos={y_col.sum()}"
    )
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Val labels shape: {y_val[:, i].shape}")
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Val features shape: {X_val_tfidf.shape}")

    model = LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        num_leaves=32,
        max_depth=-1,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        feature_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_freq=5,
        verbose=-1,
        seed=42,
        force_col_wise=True,
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train_tfidf,
        y_col,
        eval_set=[(X_val_tfidf, y_val[:, i])],
    )

    models.append(model)
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Trained model for {label}")

# Calculate validation ROC AUC scores for each column
print("\n--- Validation ROC AUC Scores ---")
auc_scores = []
for i, label in enumerate(label_names):
    val_pred = models[i].predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]
    try:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_pred)
        auc_scores.append(auc)
        model_scores[label] = auc
        print(f"{label}: {auc:.6f}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{label}: Error - {e}, score will be 0.5")
        auc_scores.append(0.5)
        model_scores[label] = 0.5

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC (Validation): {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Now prepare test set predictions - use actual test set from input
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
test_comments = test_df["comment_text"].values
print(
    f"\n[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Generating predictions on test set ({len(test_comments)} rows)..."
)

# Transform test data using the same vectorizer fitted on train
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(test_comments)

final_predictions = []
for i, label in enumerate(label_names):
    proba = models[i].predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    final_predictions.append(proba)

predictions_df = pd.DataFrame(
    zip(test_ids, *final_predictions), columns=["id"] + label_names
)

# Ensure submission file matches sample format
assert os.path.exists("./submission/submission.csv"), "Submission file not created!"
assert len(predictions_df) == len(
    sample_sub
), f"Row mismatch: {len(predictions_df)} vs {len(sample_sub)}"
assert list(predictions_df.columns) == list(
    sample_sub.columns
), f"Column mismatch: {list(predictions_df.columns)} vs {list(sample_sub.columns)}"

predictions_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(
    f"\n[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv ({len(predictions_df)} rows)"
)

# Verify submission file content
verify_df = pd.read_csv("./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Verification passed! Columns: {list(verify_df.columns)}")

# Print elapsed time
elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"Total runtime: {elapsed_time:.1f} seconds")
print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")
for label, score in sorted(model_scores.items()):
    print(f"{label}: {score:.6f}")
